== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for First Officer Thaneespi, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 19 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of January 1, 2013” (PDF made 16 April 2013): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf DecipherErrata.pdf]. Preserved copy of the sheet: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. SHA-1 of this file: ed96bb547d0da099dfc5824e2814020018b0255a. Shown on [[First Officer Thaneespi (PC Errata 2013 slip)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-8/8b/DS2-L-firstofficerthaneespi-PC-Errata-2013-slip.png Internet Archive item].
